name: Track Usages
description: Tracks usages of a certain entity type by a source entity.

suggests.drupal/linkit: Adds a 'linkit' track plugin that follows Linkit-authored links.
suggests.drupal/entity_embed: Adds an 'entity_embed' track plugin for embedded entities.
suggests.drupal/block_field: Adds a 'block_field' track plugin for block fields.
suggests.drupal/redirect: Lets the entity guesser follow redirects when resolving URLs to entities.
suggests.drupal/entity_browser_block: Adds an Entity Browser Block target plugin for Layout Builder blocks.
suggests.drupal/paragraphs: Common traversable entity type used in usage paths.

project_description: The Track Usages module tracks and registers usages of a target entity by a source entity. For instance, you can find and register the file usages of a node. The tracker service traverses intermediate entities such as media or paragraphs to reach the final target regardless of nesting level, but records only the relation between the topmost source entity and the final target entity, keeping the usage table compact. Configuration lives in 'track_usage_config' config entities, so several independent tracking scenarios can coexist (for example, node-to-file usages under one config and node-to-term usages under another). Recording can happen in real time on entity insert/update/delete, or be rebuilt in bulk via batch, queue-on-cron, or an instant run, using the admin UI or the track_usage:update Drush command. The module ships no UI for end users; it is API/infrastructure for other code to query where an entity is used.
